summary: Kaspi.kz, a Kazakhstan-based company, filed a Form 6-K to furnish its interim condensed consolidated financial information for the six months ended June 30, 2026, on its website. The report includes forward-looking statements and is incorporated by reference into its Form S-8 registration statement. This is a routine financial reporting event, not a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. The filing contains no transactional terms, strategic actions, or board recommendations. It is purely an earnings-related disclosure for a foreign private issuer.
